name: Cut-Set Constraint Obfuscation
description: Replaces the "retain the unique path" rule with a mathematically equivalent requirement based on cut-sets: retaining the "critical separation set" (bridges) for every pair of essential sites. Combined with framing the problem as satisfying O(t^2) pairwise constraints, this forces models to either perform deep algebraic reasoning to recover the O(n) subtree property, or fall into the trap of implementing an explicit O(t^2) constraint-checking loop which will fail via Time Limit Exceeded.
